periods.summary: When the war begins, Alice is thrown into Luxel's residential district and hears puppet reenactments of the villagers from the Bloody Cross massacre begging and mutilating each other. Or-Gaule reveals himself on a church roof, delighting in recreating the trauma. Alice declares that she will kill him and end every tragedy since that day. A flashback shows young Alice after the massacre: League commander Levi Ascaride harshly tells her that, as Or-Gaule's sister and survivor, she must take responsibility and stop him; Alice chooses that mission over forgetting. In battle, Alice's Invincible Armor gives her overwhelming offense, defense and regeneration. Or-Gaule uses his invisible thread nest for midair movement and psychological provocation, gradually luring her into threads. His Marionette fails because Alice's fate-weighted obsession with killing him rejects a repeat of the Bloody Cross. She pushes through Killing Opera and Deus Ex Machina projectiles, forcing Or-Gaule to improvise a strangling trap that uses Alice's own strength to tighten threads around her neck. Even while suffocating, Alice throws her axe, predicts his upward escape with threads, punches him down, crushes both hands, and begins strangling him. Or-Gaule barely escapes by manipulating threads with his toes when Alice's body spasms from oxygen deprivation, but Stella appears above him and blocks the escape with dragon fire.

key_events.summary: Resists Marionette, overwhelms Or-Gaule's threads, and nearly kills him despite suffocation.
Her pursuit corners Or-Gaule until Stella cuts off his final escape route.
